tokens.name: layout.primary
tokens.role: Modular content rails around a persistent control spine. Shared roles adapt to listening contexts and device constraints.

tokens.name: type.hierarchy
tokens.notes: No owner fonts or exact type values are stored.
tokens.role: Display, reading, and utility voices remain distinct instead of competing for emphasis. Artwork and media remain visually dominant while controls retain semantic stability.

tokens.name: color.role
tokens.notes: The role is analytical; preview colors are original study values.
tokens.role: System parts support multiple product expressions without one rigid skin.

tokens.name: interaction.priority
tokens.role: Transitions can carry tempo and continuity when they do not delay playback tasks.

tokens.name: media.strategy
tokens.notes: Destination media requires its own rights and art direction.
tokens.role: Media-led dark canvas with stable playback controls and variable content color. Product, photography, illustration, and data each receive a separate job.
